firstAttempts.stone:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original tileable game-ground MATERIAL TEXTURE, 1024x1024 opaque image, for AZMARA's narrow sandstone streets and civic courts.
Primary request: seamlessly repeating subtle irregular buff limestone/sandstone setts, individually hand-painted with dimensional small chamfered edges and fine wear. Ground is seen from high oblique orthographic/dimetric game viewpoint with gently compressed parallelogram pavers, NOT eye-level perspective. Small varied setts across image, no central motif. Colours muted buff #D6C7A6, sandstone #C2AB80, very restrained clay dust in seams, warm pale upper-left edge glints and soft brown lower-right seams; no black outlines, no white bright lines. Fine shaded 2.5D strategy-game material, not photorealism, not flat vector brick pattern. Street surface should look worn and walkable, same scale all through frame. No big paving slabs, outer borders, road outline, kerbs, vegetation, large rocks, roads, perspective narrowing, paths, buildings, people, water, labels, logos, frame, watermark or UI. Edge-to-edge seamless paver material only. Do not copy any other game.
